offer.text: My old knees can't manage the orchard ladders anymore. Would you pick me 6 apples?

accept.text: Bless you, dear. Sweet ones if you can find them.

decline.text: These old bones will go without, then.

ready.text: Six rosy apples! You've made an old soul very happy.

complete.text: Come sit with me sometime. You're always welcome.
